defs.def: to hit sb/sth quickly and lightly 轻敲；轻拍；轻叩

ex.s: The likables’ plays-well-with-others qualities strengthen schoolyard friendships, jump-start interpersonal skills and, when tapped early, are employed ever after in life and work.
ex.t: 讨人喜欢的那种"善于与人相处"的品质加强了校园友谊，启动了人际交往技能，如果及早发掘，将在以后的生活和工作中一直发挥作用。

ex.s: A lunchtime escape allows her to keep a boss from tapping her on the shoulder.
ex.t: 午餐时间的逃离让她可以避免老板拍肩膀叫她。

defs.def: if you tap your fingers, feet, etc. or they tap, you hit them gently against a table, the floor, etc., for example to the rhythm of music （用 … ）轻轻叩击

ex.s: In a study published Wednesday in Environmental Science & Technology Letters, researchers from China found that boiling tap water for just five minutes — then filtering it after it cools — could remove at least 80 percent of its microplastics.
The new study suggests boiling tap water could be a tool to limit intake.
ex.t: 为父母选择工作坊B. 准备营地课程主题

defs.def: to make use of a source of energy, knowledge, etc. that already exists 利用，开发，发掘（已有的资源、知识等）
to fit a device to a telephone so that sb's calls can be listened to secretly （在电话上）安装窃听器，搭线窃听
to cut into a tree in order to get liquid from it 在（树）上切口（导出液体）
to choose sb to do a particular job 委任；指定（某人做某事）
to produce a tap (6) 发轻拍音
to hit a surface gently to the rhythm of music （跟着音乐节奏）轻轻打拍子
to write sth using a computer or a mobile/cell phone （用计算机或移动电话）写，输入，键入
a device for controlling the flow of water from a pipe into a bath/ bathtub or sink 水龙头；旋塞

ex.s: Tap on a pipe or or whistle for help.
ex.t: 敲击管子或吹哨子求助。

ex.s: Next, the tea concentrate is poured into cups, after which water from inside the samovar is added by using the tap.
ex.t: 接下来，将浓茶汁倒入杯中，然后用茶炊上的龙头加入茶炊里的水。

ex.s: Plastic pollution is also bad, killing many birds and fish, and has even been found in our tap water.
ex.t: 塑料污染也很糟糕，害死许多鸟和鱼，甚至在我们的自来水中也发现了它。

ex.s: Humans also eat these fish, and micro plastic has even been found in tap water around the world.
ex.t: 人类也吃这些鱼，而且全球的自来水中甚至发现了微塑料。

defs.def: a device for controlling the flow of liquid or gas from a pipe or container 龙头；旋塞
a light hit with your hand or fingers 轻击；轻拍；轻敲；轻扣

ex.s: Well, say you leave the tap running while you brush your teeth, leave a light on when you go out or you drop a piece of litter and can't be bothered to pick it up.
ex.t: 嗯，比如你刷牙时让水龙头一直流着、出门时让灯亮着，或者扔了一片垃圾却懒得捡起来。

defs.def: an act of fitting a device to a telephone so that sb's telephone calls can be listened to secretly 电话窃听；搭线窃听

a speech sound which is produced by striking the tongue quickly and lightly against the part of the mouth behind the upper front teeth. The /t/ in later in American English and the /r/ in very in some British accents are examples of taps. 轻拍音
available to be used at any time 可随时使用的
beer that is on tap is in a barrel with a tap on it （啤酒）装在有旋塞的桶里的，散装的
something that is on tap is being discussed or prepared and will happen soon 协商中；准备中；即将发生
